# SeoFX

> SeoFX is an SEO company in Rajagiriya, Sri Lanka. We plan SEO before a website is built or redesigned (keywords, site structure, content and technical specs), and grow search visibility for live websites on Google, Google Maps and AI search tools. Google Ads management is available as an add-on.

Pricing: SEO Consultation from LKR 50,000 (includes on-page SEO recommendations). All other services are quoted after a free analysis.
Location: Rajagiriya, Sri Lanka. Serving businesses across Sri Lanka.
Contact: https://seofx.lk/contact-us

## Core pages
- [SEO services in Sri Lanka](https://seofx.lk/services): overview of all SEO services
- [SEO before you build](https://seofx.lk/services/seo-consulting-sri-lanka): SEO planning for new websites and redesigns
- [SEO consultation](https://seofx.lk/seo-consultant-sri-lanka): 1-on-1 SEO consultation, from LKR 50,000
- [Pricing](https://seofx.lk/seo-packages-sri-lanka): how SEO is priced and quoted
